title: Successive Schur-Riesz Analysis for Approximation
summary: Many approximation methods enlarge a trial space by adjoining function blocks generated by different operators. Exact redundancy and strong cross-level interaction can make coefficients nonunique and render pairwise or diagonal-dominance tests needlessly pessimistic. For \(V_m=\sum_{\ell\leq m}S_\ell(E_\ell)\) in a Hilbert space $\mathcal H$, we quotient coefficients representing the same function and control successive orthogonal innovations to obtain Riesz bounds independent of \(m\).
